reference: Pasta arrabbiata, serves 4. Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan on medium heat. Add 5 cloves of garlic, thinly sliced, and 2 teaspoons of red pepper flakes. Cook for about 2 minutes until the garlic is golden — be careful, it goes from golden to burnt really fast. Add 2 cans of crushed tomatoes (400g each), season with salt, and simmer for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook 400g spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Save about half a cup of pasta water before draining. Toss the pasta into the sauce and add a splash of pasta water if it's too thick. Finish with fresh parsley and parmesan if you like — though technically arrabbiata is vegan so you don't have to.
